title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
description: Given an integer array `nums`, return the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence in O(n log n) time.
input_format: First line contains integer `n`, followed by `n` integers.
output_format: Length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.
hints: Patience sorting with binary search achieves O(n log n).
Maintain `tails[i]` storing the smallest tail of all increasing subsequences of length i + 1.

reference_solution:
import sys, bisect
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    nums = [int(x) for x in data[1:1+n]]
    tails = []
    for x in nums:
        idx = bisect.bisect_left(tails, x)
        if idx == len(tails): tails.append(x)
        else: tails[idx] = x
    print(len(tails))
